title: Congress.gov Recent Bills and Actions
description: Snapshots recent legislation from the official Congress.gov API. Each row identifies a bill with congress / type (HR / S / HJRES / SJRES) / number, title, sponsor, originating chamber, latest action text + date, importance tier (HIGH for chamber passage, signed-into-law, or veto; MEDIUM for committee reports or floor amendments; LOW for introductions), and a policy-area tag (Healthcare, Energy, Finance, Defense, Tech, Immigration, Tax, Trade, Climate, Civil Rights, Other). Powers the Politics & Policy Prediction Brief: HIGH-importance bills move sector ETFs and issue equities reliably (e.g., chip subsidies → SOXX / chip stocks; permitting reform → XLE; healthcare cost caps → XLV / individual drug names). Free Congress.gov API requires CONGRESS_GOV_API_KEY (free signup at api.congress.gov). Round-6 (2026-05-02): tightened importance classifier so SRES/HRES (single-chamber commemorative resolutions like "Awareness Month" or "congratulating Little League") never tier above LOW; dropped overly-broad "agreed to" pattern from HIGH which was misclassifying every procedural agreement; added specific bicameral milestones (conference report agreed to, House/Senate concurred in).
code:
import pandas as pd
import requests
import re
from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta

now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
now_epoch = int(now.timestamp())
from_date = (now - timedelta(days=14)).strftime('%Y-%m-%dT00:00:00Z')

API_KEY = CREDENTIALS.get('CONGRESS_GOV_API_KEY', '')
BASE = 'https://api.congress.gov/v3/bill'

EXPECTED_COLUMNS = [
    'bill_id', 'congress', 'bill_type', 'bill_number',
    'title', 'origin_chamber', 'sponsor_party', 'sponsor_state',
    'latest_action_date', 'latest_action_text',
    'importance_tier', 'policy_area', 'url', '_epoch',
]

POLICY_KEYWORDS = [
    ('Healthcare', re.compile(r'\b(health|medicare|medicaid|insurance|hospital|drug pricing|prescription|pharmaceutical|fda|nih|cdc|public health|mental health|opioid)\b', re.I)),
    ('Energy', re.compile(r'\b(energy|oil|gas|coal|nuclear|solar|wind|renewable|climate|emissions|electric grid|petroleum|drilling|pipeline|carbon)\b', re.I)),
    ('Finance', re.compile(r'\b(financ|bank|securities|sec|cftc|federal reserve|cryptocurrency|crypto|stablecoin|consumer protection|cfpb|investment|wall street|systemic risk)\b', re.I)),
    ('Defense', re.compile(r'\b(defense|military|armed forces|veterans|navy|air force|army|marines|coast guard|nato|weapons|munitions|nuclear weapons|aukus)\b', re.I)),
    ('Tech', re.compile(r'\b(technology|semiconductor|chip|artificial intelligence|ai\b|machine learning|data privacy|cybersecurity|broadband|telecommunications|5g|spectrum|antitrust|big tech|social media)\b', re.I)),
    ('Immigration', re.compile(r'\b(immigration|border|asylum|refugee|visa|deport|naturalization|customs|ice\b|cbp\b)\b', re.I)),
    ('Tax', re.compile(r'\b(tax|irs|revenue|deduction|credit|exemption|tariff)\b', re.I)),
    ('Trade', re.compile(r'\b(trade|tariff|export|import|sanction|wto|china|nafta|usmca)\b', re.I)),
    ('Climate', re.compile(r'\b(climate change|carbon|greenhouse|epa|environment|conservation|wildlife|endangered|wetland)\b', re.I)),
    ('Civil Rights', re.compile(r'\b(civil rights|voting|discrimination|equal protection|abortion|firearm|second amendment|free speech)\b', re.I)),
]

HIGH_IMPACT_PATTERNS = [
    re.compile(r'became public law', re.I),
    re.compile(r'signed by president', re.I),
    re.compile(r'vetoed', re.I),
    re.compile(r'\bpassed\s+(?:house|senate)\b', re.I),
    re.compile(r'on passage passed', re.I),
    re.compile(r'cleared for white house', re.I),
    re.compile(r'presented to president', re.I),
    # Specific bicameral milestones - broader 'agreed to' was the
    # round-5 audit bug. Every ceremonial resolution's procedural
    # history contains 'agreed to without amendment...' so SRES/HRES
    # rows like 'congratulating the Little League' got HIGH-tiered.
    re.compile(r'conference report agreed to', re.I),
    re.compile(r'(?:house|senate)\s+concurred\s+in', re.I),
]

MEDIUM_IMPACT_PATTERNS = [
    re.compile(r'reported by committee', re.I),
    re.compile(r'committee report', re.I),
    re.compile(r'placed on calendar', re.I),
    re.compile(r'committee discharged', re.I),
    re.compile(r'amendment\b', re.I),
    re.compile(r'placed on union calendar', re.I),
    re.compile(r'reported with(?:out)?\s+amendment', re.I),
]

# Single-chamber resolutions (SRES = Senate Resolution, HRES = House
# Resolution) cannot become law - they're procedural / commemorative
# only ('Deep Vein Thrombosis Awareness Month', 'congratulating the
# Little League winners', etc). Cap at LOW regardless of action_text.
# HCONRES / SCONRES (concurrent resolutions, both chambers but not
# president) keep their tier-ability because budget resolutions live
# there and DO move markets when agreed to. S, HR, HJRES, SJRES are
# real bills.
ALWAYS_LOW_BILL_TYPES = ('SRES', 'HRES')

def classify_importance(action_text, bill_type):
    if not action_text:
        return 'LOW'
    if bill_type in ALWAYS_LOW_BILL_TYPES:
        return 'LOW'
    for pi in range(len(HIGH_IMPACT_PATTERNS)):
        if HIGH_IMPACT_PATTERNS[pi].search(action_text):
            return 'HIGH'
    for pi in range(len(MEDIUM_IMPACT_PATTERNS)):
        if MEDIUM_IMPACT_PATTERNS[pi].search(action_text):
            return 'MEDIUM'
    return 'LOW'

def classify_policy(title):
    if not title:
        return 'Other'
    for entry_idx in range(len(POLICY_KEYWORDS)):
        area = POLICY_KEYWORDS[entry_idx][0]
        pat = POLICY_KEYWORDS[entry_idx][1]
        if pat.search(title):
            return area
    return 'Other'

rows = []
offset = 0
page_size = 50
max_pages = 4
for page_idx in range(max_pages):
    try:
        resp = requests.get(
            BASE,
            params={
                'api_key': API_KEY,
                'format': 'json',
                'offset': offset,
                'limit': page_size,
                'sort': 'updateDate+desc',
                'fromDateTime': from_date,
            },
            timeout=30,
        )
        resp.raise_for_status()
        payload = resp.json() or {}
        bills = payload.get('bills', []) or []
    except Exception:
        break
    if not bills:
        break
    for bi in range(len(bills)):
        b = bills[bi]
        if not isinstance(b, dict):
            continue
        congress = b.get('congress', 0)
        bill_type = (b.get('type', '') or '').upper()
        bill_number = b.get('number', '')
        title = b.get('title', '') or ''
        origin_chamber = b.get('originChamber', '') or ''
        latest_action_obj = b.get('latestAction', {}) or {}
        action_date = latest_action_obj.get('actionDate', '') if isinstance(latest_action_obj, dict) else ''
        action_text = latest_action_obj.get('text', '') if isinstance(latest_action_obj, dict) else ''
        url = b.get('url', '') or ''
        sponsor_party = ''
        sponsor_state = ''
        sponsors = b.get('sponsors', []) or []
        if sponsors and isinstance(sponsors, list) and len(sponsors) > 0:
            sp = sponsors[0]
            if isinstance(sp, dict):
                sponsor_party = sp.get('party', '') or ''
                sponsor_state = sp.get('state', '') or ''
        bill_id = bill_type + str(bill_number) + '-' + str(congress)
        importance = classify_importance(action_text, bill_type)
        policy_area = classify_policy(title)
        rows.append({
            'bill_id': bill_id,
            'congress': int(congress) if congress else 0,
            'bill_type': bill_type,
            'bill_number': str(bill_number),
            'title': title,
            'origin_chamber': origin_chamber,
            'sponsor_party': sponsor_party,
            'sponsor_state': sponsor_state,
            'latest_action_date': action_date,
            'latest_action_text': action_text,
            'importance_tier': importance,
            'policy_area': policy_area,
            'url': url,
            '_epoch': now_epoch,
        })
    if len(bills) < page_size:
        break
    offset = offset + page_size

if rows:
    df = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=EXPECTED_COLUMNS)
else:
    df = pd.DataFrame(columns=EXPECTED_COLUMNS)

GENERATE_RESULTS(df)
